description: Start a May creative run for one client: research, copy, and eight ad concepts, delivered to the portal for the customer to review and edit. Usually under a minute. May builds creative and, separately in the portal, a PAUSED campaign. It never turns anything on and never spends ad budget. The client needs a confirmed brand profile first, which is filled in at makometrics.com/portal. Needs the May plan and a Mako customer connection.
